answer: An agent marketplace weights governance votes by tokens locked for 90 days, rather than by account count. Whether an agent sells glacier forecasts, appraises a relic, or predicts a gale, creating more identities cannot multiply its voting power: splitting 100 tokens across 100 accounts still yields only 100 votes. To gain influence, an attacker must buy and immobilize more tokens, tying up capital and bearing price risk throughout the lock.
